name: Bun Kabab
description: Pakistani street-style bun kabab with hot shami kabab, egg, chutneys, onion and chaat masala in a lightly toasted bun.
ingredients: Cooking oil, for frying and toasting
method: Heat a little oil in a pan and shallow-fry the prepared shami kababs until hot through and browned on both sides.
Season the beaten eggs lightly if desired, pour into the pan and cook as a thin omelette; divide it among the four buns or coat the kababs in egg according to your preferred bun-kabab style.
Split the buns and toast the cut sides lightly on the pan so they are warm without becoming hard.
Spread green chutney and tamarind chutney over the toasted buns, adjusting the sweet, sour and spicy balance to taste.
Place a hot kabab and egg in each bun, then add sliced onion and a light sprinkle of chaat masala.
Close the buns and serve immediately while the kabab is hot and the bread is still lightly crisp at the edges.
